query: Run /update-resonance. I have uncommitted application files, but none of them are under .agents, .forge, command shims, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or .resonance memory files.
expected_behavior: Does not demand a completely clean worktree just because unrelated application files are dirty
Classifies dirty paths by ownership before deciding whether to proceed
Proceeds only if the write set excludes the dirty application files
Reports the unrelated dirty paths as context left untouched
Stops if any touched managed path has conflicts or unknown ownership
